flows.title: USDC exchanged for USDT in one transaction
flows.endpoint: USDT subsequently distributed; 46,100 USDT returned to the source candidate
flows.explanation: The successful receipt records 274,999 USDC entering a contract route and a main output of 272,074.135714 USDT. Subsequent verified USDT transfers include 46,100 returned to the source candidate and 177,100 sent to one other address across four payments. The recipient later received additional funds; no customer authorization or Fusion settlement link is established. An earlier Arbitrum receipt now shows this recipient funding the known candidate with 274,999 USDC and a memo requesting Ethereum USDT, supporting a cross-chain exchange interpretation.
flows.limitation: The displayed path ends at the main USDT recipient; the report lists subsequent distributions. Its pinned balance on 2026-10-13 was 0.166778 USDT. Receipt verification covers 29 returned explorer rows, not an independently complete history. Mixed later funding prevents assigning every later payment to the original output. The full report links the Arbitrum input and explains the small memo/output difference.

flows.title: Large payment with no accepted direct burn match
flows.endpoint: 100,000 USDC reached a Netcoins-labelled address; 316,050.300000 USDC entered Hyperliquid via Arbitrum
flows.explanation: This Ethereum payment remains without an accepted Fusion burn match. Its recipient later sent 100,000 USDC through another address to the address Etherscan labels Netcoins 1. A separate 316,050.404450-USDC branch used Circle CCTP: 316,050.304450 USDC was minted to the same recipient address on Arbitrum, with matching message nonce and body. The Arbitrum recipient then deposited 316,050.300000 USDC into the officially documented Hyperliquid bridge. The venue ledger independently records that transaction, later withdrawals and more deposits; available fills show BTC trading activity. A 416,154.953803-USDC inflow 24 seconds earlier requests Fusion issuance and is followed by a matching quoted mint; it does not supply a payout instruction to this recipient. See the terminal review for funding context.
flows.limitation: Both branches belong to the original payment; their amounts are not additional vault outflows. Current queried venue states and the pinned Arbitrum balance are zero. Ownership, customer authorization and a loss amount remain unproven.
